method: Single commit on latest integration base; import only selected Git paths with exact source blob identity; no branch history merge.
non_ff_reason: The verification branch diverged before current planning, prior batch integrations, and product-owner-authorized schema change. Fast-forward is impossible. Merging/replacing its full tree would risk importing obsolete plan/schema state.
history_policy: Original FAIL report and evidence copied verbatim from old_fail_sha. Embedded original evidence paths are unchanged; resolve them against the round-1 archive root.
prior_integration_policy: All paths outside the above scope must have identical tree entries to base_sha; schema, contract lock, plans, other batch artifacts and dependency lock remain at the latest base.
